TRY A COMPLETE CASE / NEW SYNTHETIC DATA

The MyCAT case kit

Can a JPG filename conceal a PDF? Download the kit, upload MyCAT.jpg, inspect its header and trailer, then export a recovery copy. Upload that copy alongside MyCAT-original.pdf: the type and SHA-256 should match.

The historical File05 and original MyCAT bytes are unavailable. Click “Use MyCAT Example” to analyze the preset directly without downloading.

Files remain in this browser. Signature matches are triage indicators, not proof of validity, authenticity, or safety. Uploaded files are inspected as bytes and never executed. Only the bundled synthetic audio can be played.

Interactive hex viewer

Header — distinctive bytes near the start that help identify a format.

Trailer — an end marker used by some formats. Its presence supports inspection, but does not prove the file is complete.

Offset — a byte’s position, counted from zero. Use decimal or hexadecimal (0x…).

Blue = matched header · amber = trailer · click a byte for its offset and value
